chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Usman ibn Isa, from the one who informed him, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
‘The best of the foods is the rice, and we preserve it for our sick ones’.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and physical significance of rice in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elevates rice (*al-aruzz*) to the status of an optimal sustenance, specifically designating it as a restorative remedy for the ill. This reflects the broader Shia medical tradition that views dietary choices as integral to physical and spiritual well-being, emphasizing moderation and the therapeutic properties of staple grains.
